chapter: Riverboat to New Orleans and Horace Henderson
title: Horace Henderson's trumpet section: Red Holland, Bernice Morton and Roy
summary: The band's trumpets were Roy, Bernice Morton (Spratt) and Matthew 'Red' Holland, all but Roy from the Louisville kid band; when Red left, Jones took his place, his second professional job.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: How do you spell his name, B-e-r-n-i-c-e?

And he was -- well, he's deceased now, but he was a nice little trumpet player. He was out of the band. There was a whole trumpet section, all but Roy -- they had Red Holland on trumpet. I spoke about him before. Matthew Holland was his name. And he left --
Wasn't he the one that played the baritone?
Matthew was a trumpet player that played around here with Charlie Johnson and different bands, you know.

And then he finally dropped out of sight. I don't know what happened to him. I used to see him years ago. He left Horace, and then let's see, had him, and this guy I told you, Bernice Morton, and Roy. And that was the trumpet section of Horace Henderson's band. And so he left, Red left, Red Holland left, and then they sent for me. So I come into the band and then there was me and Bernice Morton and Roy.
Well, that was your second professional job.
Well, that was a pretty good break, wasn't it?
